title: tc-side-nav
description: An app's main navigation down the side: brand, places with icons and badges, the current page, a footer of your own.

current.description: The id of the current page's item – it gets aria-current="page"

brand.description: The product's name at the top

brandHref.description: Where the brand links to; without it the brand is plain text

collapsible.description: Adds the button that folds the bar into a rail and back

labels.description: The collapse button's words, merged over defaultSideNavLabels

id.description: Your key for the item: `current` names it, tc-navigate hands it back

label.description: Its name, shown beside the icon

href.description: A link; without one the item is a button that only fires tc-navigate

badge.description: A count or short word after the label: 12, "New"

disabled.description: Shown dimmed; it can't be chosen

section.description: A caption over a group of items; consecutive items with the same section share it
